# Clean Yield

> Clean Yield publishes data tools (Actors) on the Apify platform that return structured, ready-to-use rows from public web sources and official open data. Every Actor is pay per result (no subscription, no platform usage fee on top), does not charge failed or incomplete results, respects a maximum cost per run, and has a Lite version with no per-result charge limited to 25 results per run.

Run any Actor from the Apify Store, the Apify API (`POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/cleanyield~<actor-name>/run-sync-get-dataset-items` with an Apify token and the input as JSON; add `maxTotalChargeUsd` to cap the cost), n8n, Make, or AI agents through the Apify MCP server. Prices below are for the Apify Free plan; paid Apify plans get lower tiers.

## Actors

- [Company Enrichment from Website](https://apify.com/cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website): Turns a list of company websites or domains into one row per company with contact emails, phone numbers and address when the site publishes them, LinkedIn and social profiles, the tech stack the site runs on and hiring signals. Returns one row per company: companyName, description, country, language; emails; phones, primaryPhone; address; socialProfiles; technologies; hiring. Input: domains (or full website URLs); optional sections, maxPagesPerDomain, includePersonalEmails. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge) (up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website-lite. Price today: USD 10 per 1,000 companies (USD 0.01 per company returned) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 7 per 1,000). From November 24, 2026: The Gold tier moves to USD 7.50 per 1,000, and monitor mode adds USD 0.005 per watched company per monitor run (today monitor mode charges only new or changed companies).
- [ATS Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper): Returns the live open jobs of any company straight from its own careers page on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Recruitee, Personio or Teamtailor, in one format, with no expired listings. Returns one row per job: title, department, company; location, city, countryCode, workplaceType; employmentType; salaryAnnualMin, salaryAnnualMax, salaryCurrency, salaryText; postedAt, url, applyUrl; descriptionText / descriptionHtml. Input: companies (names, board tokens or careers page URLs); optional keywords, locations, workplaceTypes, postedWithinDays, maxJobsPerCompany. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge) (up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper-lite. Price today: USD 2 per 1,000 jobs (USD 0.002 per job) plus USD 0.005 per run, on the Apify Free plan; Silver and Gold subscribers pay USD 1.20 per 1,000. From November 24, 2026: USD 5 per 1,000 jobs (USD 0.005 per job) plus USD 0.005 per run; Silver and Gold USD 3 per 1,000.
- [FMCSA Carrier Lookup](https://apify.com/cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data): Looks up US trucking companies by USDOT or MC number, or lists carriers by state, city, ZIP code or radius, including the ones that registered in the last days, from official FMCSA data. Returns one row per carrier: dotNumber, mcNumbers, legalName, companyName; usdotStatus, authorityStatus, authority; insurancePolicies, insuranceSummary; safety, safetyRating, outOfService; powerUnits, drivers, cargoCarried, physicalAddress; phone, email; leadScore, leadTier. Input: dotNumbers or mcNumbers; or states, cities, zipCodes, nearLocation + radiusMiles, addedWithinDays, entityTypes. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge) (up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data-lite. Price today: USD 5 per 1,000 carriers (USD 0.005 per carrier) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 3.50 per 1,000). From November 24, 2026: Monitor mode adds USD 0.001 per watched carrier per monitor run (today monitor mode charges only new or changed carriers). The price per carrier does not change.
- [App Store & Google Play Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews): Returns the reviews of any iPhone (App Store) or Android (Google Play) app in one format, for any country and language, with filters by rating, date and keyword. Returns one row per review: store, appName, appId; rating, title, text; date, appVersion; country, language; developerReply; url, thumbsUp. Input: apps (App Store or Google Play links or IDs); optional countries, languages, maxReviewsPerApp, minRating, maxRating, reviewsSince, keywords. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge) (up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews-lite. Price today: USD 0.10 per 1,000 reviews (10,000 reviews = USD 1) on the Apify Free plan; subscribers pay slightly less. From November 24, 2026: Monitor mode checks cost USD 0.01 per app per monitor run (USD 0.005 today). The price per review does not change.
- [Latin America Public Tenders](https://apify.com/cleanyield/latam-public-tenders): Returns public tenders from Colombia (SECOP), Brazil (PNCP), Chile (Mercado Público) and Paraguay (DNCP) in one format, with an English title, the amount in USD when the tender states one, the buyer and the bid deadline. Returns one row per tender: tenderId, country, source, url; title, titleEn, description; buyer; amount (value, currency, valueUsd); status, procedureType; publishedDate, closingDate; awardees. Input: countries, sectors or keywords, status; optional publishedWithinDays, minAmountUsd, buyers, tenderIds. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge) (up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/latam-public-tenders-lite. Price today: USD 8 per 1,000 tenders (USD 0.008 per tender) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 6.20 per 1,000).

## Use-case pages

- [Company enrichment API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/company-enrichment-api/): Company enrichment API by domain: send company websites, get emails, phones and address when published, LinkedIn, socials, tech stack and hiring signals.
- [Find company emails from a website](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/find-company-emails-from-website/): Find company emails from any website: paste domains, get generic and role emails with the page they came from, phones when published and social profiles.
- [Greenhouse jobs API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/greenhouse-jobs-api/): Greenhouse jobs API: type a company name or board URL and get its live open jobs with location, remote type, salary when posted and apply link, in JSON or CSV.
- [Workday jobs scraper](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/workday-jobs-scraper/): Workday jobs scraper: paste any myworkdayjobs.com careers site and get its live job postings with location, remote type, date, apply URL and salary when posted.
- [Job postings data API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/job-postings-data-api/): Job postings data API: live jobs from company careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workday, filtered by keyword, location or remote; salary if posted.
- [FMCSA carrier lookup API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/fmcsa-carrier-lookup-api/): FMCSA carrier lookup API: search by USDOT or MC number, state or ZIP and get authority status, insurance on file, safety, fleet size, phone and a lead score.
- [App Store reviews API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/app-store-reviews-api/): App Store reviews API: paste an iPhone app link and get its reviews with rating, title, text, date and app version, for any country, filtered by stars or date.
- [Google Play reviews scraper](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/google-play-reviews-scraper/): Google Play reviews scraper: paste an Android app link and get its reviews with rating, text, date, app version and developer reply, by language, JSON or CSV.
- [API de licitaciones públicas](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/licitaciones-publicas-api/): API de licitaciones públicas de Colombia (SECOP), Chile (Mercado Público), Brasil (PNCP) y Paraguay: monto en USD, comprador, fecha de cierre, título en inglés.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/llms-full.txt): field-by-field output, a real input and output example and an API call for every Actor
- [Clean Yield on Apify](https://apify.com/cleanyield): publisher profile with all Actors
